name: agent-blueprint
description: Create and validate compact, agent-readable software blueprints and bounded reconstruction contracts, reusable across programming languages and agent runtimes.

interface.longDescription: Create compact whole-product BLUEPRINT.md files and independently implementable scoped contracts, grounded in existing project authorities with verifiable acceptance and no duplicated ownership.
interface.defaultPrompt: Create a compact BLUEPRINT.md for this project, preserving existing authorities and extracting scoped contracts only where useful.
